correctness.rationale: Three independent uniformly sampled eccentric anomalies on axis-aligned ellipse (a cosθ,b sinθ), a>=b>0, are NOT uniform arclength points. For a fixed first angle α, two independent differences U,V uniform (0,π), and Δ=U−V has triangular density. The chord inner product under diag(a,b) has sign cosΔ+τ cos(2m) for τ=(a²−b²)/(a²+b²); uniform α makes m uniform mod π independent of Δ. Integrating the obtuse probability gives one angle P_obtuse=1/4+[1/(2π²)]Li₂(τ²), by arcsin² Taylor series and averaged cosine even moments. Three mutually exclusive obtuse events imply P_acute=1/4−3/(2π²)Li₂(τ²). Positive series coefficients establish strict shape monotonicity, Taylor expansion τ=tanh(log r) gives near-circle expansion, and dilog reflection near τ²=1 gives slender asymptotic 6/(π² r²)(2log r+1−log4)+O(log r/r⁴). Independent 400-node Gaussian quadrature of arcsin² for r=1,1.5,2,4,10 matched formula to ~1e−14; Monte Carlo in inspected checker is only corroboration.
